hero.title: HashiCorp Certifications
hero.description: Each certification program tests both conceptual knowledge and real-world experience using HashiCorp multi-cloud tools. A HashiCorp certification communicates your proficiency and employers can quickly verify your results.

announcement.heading: TechXchange is Coming
announcement.text: You can take two free exams with the purchase of a HashiConf at TechXchange ticket.

certificationPrograms.containerDescription: We offer Terraform certifications at three levels. Validate foundational Terraform knowledge with Terraform Associate. Then, demonstrate professional and advanced experience with the Terraform Infrastructure Engineer and the lab-based Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced certification.

Earn an associate-level certification to validate foundational Vault knowledge and skills. Showcase your production-ready Vault operational experience when you pass the Vault Operations Advanced exam.
